rationale: The cited evidence (S-010-R1) addresses recovery timing but lacks explicit observability analysis regarding shared perception inputs. Additionally, the project reasoning assumes the failed perception output lacks detectable metadata (e.g., uncertainty scores, temporal inconsistencies, or confidence bounds) that a monitor could potentially use to identify a failure even when relying on the same shared input.
limitations: Requires explicit observability analysis of perception outputs, including whether uncertainty or confidence metadata could allow a monitor to detect failures from shared inputs.
